objections.claim: Decision 5 genesis-failure deferral to FAFF-1305 is a scope mismatch; lights-out genesis orphan is unowned and leaves a live owner.status:running ledger that the live-higher-level guard trips on.

Scenarios drive faff lights-out past the L4 preflight on a tmp root with no stubbing seam named; init-self-drain mint has no preflight so the cited test model does not transfer; AC1-AC4 not decidable.
AC5 non-ENOENT discard branch not reliably producible by a black-box tmp-root test; no stubbing mechanism named.

The named harness config (budget.tokens ceiling + autonomous.engine_bounded:true) is under-specified: it omits the fuller tmpRoot() fixture (slots review/spec_review occupants, gates.fallback: fail-closed, on_estimate_only: warn) needed to pass budget-metering (FAFF-428) and dial-coherence (FAFF-298), so scenarios 1-4 are not executable exactly as the parenthetical describes.

The 'complete set the preflight needs' claim is false for the in-process path: cmdLightsOut(args, commands) builds knownCommands from its second parameter; a caller that does not thread faff's COMMANDS registry makes all seven CLI-backed guardrails read absent (FAFF-899 floor), so the preflight refuses before mintLightsOut is called.

Same: the test-mechanism paragraph claims completeness but omits threading the COMMANDS registry into cmdLightsOut, so scenarios 1-4 stubs never fire; spec must name passing the full COMMANDS registry as bin/faff does.
